description: Receiptor connects AI agents to your bookkeeping workspace so they can find, review, and organize financial documents such as receipts, bills, and invoices. Use it to inspect workspace context, monitor intake sources, review extracted document data, check integrations, and prepare accountant-ready workflows through secure OAuth access to Receiptor AI.

tool_signatures.name: activity_search
tool_signatures.description: Search past source activity logs across email, WhatsApp, and uploads. For email sources, this first searches connected providers, then cross-checks matching message IDs against stored activity logs and returns any saved processing reasoning.

limit.description: Maximum number of activity items to return.

query.description: Natural-language or exact search query such as merchant, sender, or invoice keyword.

sourceTypes.description: Which source activity types to search.

providerResultLimit.description: Maximum number of provider search matches to cross-check before filtering activity logs.

includeSourceDetails.description: Whether to reload matching provider messages for richer email details like subject, sender, and snippet.

tool_signatures.name: approvals_approve
tool_signatures.description: Approve a pending approval request and execute the stored capability input.

tool_signatures.name: approvals_get
tool_signatures.description: Get the details of a pending or resolved approval request by ID.

tool_signatures.name: approvals_reject
tool_signatures.description: Reject a pending approval request without executing the stored capability input.

tool_signatures.name: chartOfAccounts_listAccounts
tool_signatures.description: List or search accounts from the active chart of accounts for the current workspace so the agent can ground categorization decisions.

tool_signatures.name: currency_convert
tool_signatures.description: Convert amounts between different currencies. Uses current rates by default, or historical rates for a specific date.

date.description: Optional date for historical rates (YYYY-MM-DD format). Defaults to current rates if not provided.

tool_signatures.name: documents_bulk-edit
tool_signatures.description: Bulk edit documents. Supports dry-run preview (default) and execute modes. Preview returns matching documents with proposed changes and available merchants/categories for context.

where.description: Typed filter clause for targeted bulk edits. Allowed fields: amount, docDate, merchant, category, docType, invoiceId, receiptId, preferredCurrency, currency, paymentMethod, paymentMethodEnding, fromEmail, toEmail, summary, taxAmount, subtotal, isRecurring, recurringType, entityId. Allowed ops: eq, ne, gt, gte, lt, lte, in, nin, regex, exists.

dryRun.description: If true, shows preview without making changes. If false, executes the bulk edit.

labels.description: Replace labels with this exact set

shouldClearLabels.description: If true, remove all labels from matching documents

changes.description: Changes to apply to matching documents

category.description: Specific category to filter for editing

merchant.description: Specific merchant to filter for editing

documentIds.description: Exact document IDs to edit. Use this for deterministic single-document or hand-picked multi-document edits.

tool_signatures.name: documents_count
tool_signatures.description: Count documents and aggregate data. Use for spending totals and financial analysis. Supports grouping by merchant, category, date, export status, etc. Gets ALL matching documents.

where.description: Typed filter clause. Allowed fields: amount, docDate, merchant, category, docType, invoiceId, receiptId, preferredCurrency, currency, paymentMethod, paymentMethodEnding, fromEmail, toEmail, summary, taxAmount, subtotal, isRecurring, recurringType, entityId. Allowed ops: eq, ne, gt, gte, lt, lte, in, nin, regex, exists. Regex filters are already case-insensitive, so pass plain values like "grab" instead of inline flags like "(?i)grab".

groupBy.description: Aggregation key. Allowed values: merchant, category, docType, currency, preferredCurrency, paymentMethod, paymentMethodEnding, entityId, docDate, exportStatus. Use exportStatus to summarize exported vs not-exported documents.

archived.description: Archive filter: exclude (default, active docs), only (archived docs), include (both).

exportStatus.description: Optional export status filter before aggregation

tool_signatures.name: documents_delete
tool_signatures.description: Soft-delete a document (receipt, invoice, etc.). The document is archived and can be recovered. Also archives any duplicate documents and cleans up cross-references.

tool_signatures.name: documents_get
tool_signatures.description: Retrieve a single document by ID with full details. Returns all extracted fields including merchant info, line items, amounts, file URL, and source.

tool_signatures.name: documents_inspect
tool_signatures.description: Inspect the original document file (image/PDF) with a vision model and compare visible values against currently stored extracted fields.

fields.description: Specific fields to inspect from file. Defaults to core financial fields.

maxPages.description: For PDFs, maximum pages to inspect (1-5). Defaults to 3.

tool_signatures.name: documents_list-duplicates
tool_signatures.description: List existing duplicate document groups for the current workspace.

offset.description: Number of duplicate groups to skip

tool_signatures.name: documents_resolve-duplicates
tool_signatures.description: Analyze a selected set of documents as possible duplicates. Use dryRun=true (default) to preview the recommended canonical/master document first. Use dryRun=false with masterId to apply the duplicate grouping and archive the non-master duplicates.

dryRun.description: If true, preview duplicate resolution. If false, apply the chosen master/duplicate grouping.

masterId.description: Canonical document to keep. Required only when dryRun=false and must be one of documentIds.

documentIds.description: Document IDs to analyze as a possible duplicate set

tool_signatures.name: documents_scan-duplicates
tool_signatures.description: Scan active unresolved documents in the current workspace for likely duplicate groups. Read-only: returns candidate groups and recommended canonical documents without mutating data.

limit.description: Maximum candidate duplicate groups to return

tool_signatures.name: documents_search
tool_signatures.description: Search, filter, and retrieve user's documents. Supports text search, filtering by document type, export status, date ranges, sorting, and semantic similarity. Use documents.count for totals or grouped summaries across all matching documents.

query.description: Text query (used only when useSearch=true). Omit in filter-only mode.

where.description: Typed filter clause. Allowed fields: amount, docDate, merchant, category, docType, invoiceId, receiptId, preferredCurrency, currency, paymentMethod, paymentMethodEnding, fromEmail, toEmail, summary, taxAmount, subtotal, isRecurring, recurringType, entityId. Allowed ops: eq, ne, gt, gte, lt, lte, in, nin, regex, exists. Regex filters are already case-insensitive, so pass plain values like "grab" instead of inline flags like "(?i)grab".

archived.description: Archive filter: exclude (default, active docs), only (archived docs), include (both).

searchType.description: Search mode when useSearch=true: similarity (exact-ish) or mmr (broader)

requiredFields.description: Always include these extra fields (in addition to outputMode defaults). Allowed fields: id, merchant, amount, currency, preferredCurrency, conversionRate, date, category, docType, summary, invoiceId, receiptId, exportStatus, link.

tool_signatures.name: documents_unarchive
tool_signatures.description: Restore a previously archived document so it is active again.

id.description: The archived document ID to restore

tool_signatures.name: documents_update
tool_signatures.description: Update a single document by ID. Use this for precise corrections to extracted document fields that should not be applied through bulk edit.

amount.description: Document amount in major currency units (for example 12.34)

subtotal.description: Subtotal in major currency units (for example 11.11)

taxAmount.description: Tax amount in major currency units (for example 1.23)

changes.description: Single-document edits. Does not support fromEmail or toEmail.

tool_signatures.name: entities_cleanup
tool_signatures.description: Analyze and clean up the user's own business entities: enrich with Google Places data, find duplicates via place_id and embedding similarity, and merge them. This is for companies/legal entities/subsidiaries, not merchant or document duplicates.

dryRun.description: Preview changes without executing. Set to false after user confirms.

maxEntities.description: Maximum number of entities to process in one invocation

tool_signatures.name: entities_delete
tool_signatures.description: Delete a business entity and unlink associated documents.

entityId.description: ID of the entity to delete

tool_signatures.name: entities_list
tool_signatures.description: List and search business entities with pagination.

search.description: Search term to filter entities by name, address, or aliases

tool_signatures.name: entities_merge
tool_signatures.description: Merge multiple business entities into one. Reassigns all linked documents to the kept entity, adds merged entity names as aliases, and deletes the duplicates.

keepEntityId.description: ID of the business entity to keep as the canonical record

mergeEntityIds.description: IDs of business entities to merge into the kept entity. Their names become aliases and linked documents are reassigned.

tool_signatures.name: entities_upsert
tool_signatures.description: Create a new business entity or update an existing one.

entityId.description: Entity ID to update. Omit to create a new entity.

tool_signatures.name: exports_get
tool_signatures.description: Get one export record by ID for the current workspace.

id.description: The export record ID to fetch

tool_signatures.name: exports_list
tool_signatures.description: List export records with filters (document, integration, date range) for the current workspace.

documentId.description: Filter export records by document ID

integrationSlug.description: Filter export records by integration (xero, quickbooks, google-drive, etc.)

tool_signatures.name: get_server_info
tool_signatures.description: Get information about the Receiptor MCP server

tool_signatures.name: integrations_list
tool_signatures.description: List available integrations for the user. Can filter by category (email, accounting, storage, social, banking) and status. Returns integration IDs needed for sendToIntegration, reconcileWithIntegration, and other operations.

tool_signatures.name: integrations_reconcile
tool_signatures.description: Reconcile a document (receipt/invoice) with a supported banking integration such as Mercury. Requires integrationId. targetId is optional for Mercury. Set dryRun=true (default) to preview, dryRun=false to queue for reconciliation.

dryRun.description: If true, shows preview without reconciling. If false, queues the document for reconciliation.

targetId.description: Optional target ID from listIntegrations. Use for Mercury account IDs when narrowing reconciliation.

documentId.description: The receipt/invoice document ID to reconcile

integrationId.description: The banking integration ID to reconcile with (use listIntegrations to find)

tool_signatures.name: integrations_send
tool_signatures.description: Send a document (receipt/invoice) to a supported accounting integration (Xero or QuickBooks). Requires integrationId. targetId is required for Xero/QuickBooks. Set dryRun=true (default) to preview, dryRun=false to queue for sending.

dryRun.description: If true, shows preview without sending. If false, queues the document for sending.

targetId.description: Optional target ID from listIntegrations. Use for accounting tenants or companies.

documentId.description: The receipt/invoice document ID to send

integrationId.description: The integration ID to send to (use listIntegrations to find)

tool_signatures.name: integrations_unlink
tool_signatures.description: Unlink a document from an integration (supports Xero and QuickBooks). Set dryRun=true (default) to preview, including invoice details and orphaned attachments. Set dryRun=false to execute. This action is IRREVERSIBLE.

dryRun.description: If true, shows preview without making changes. If false, executes the unlinking.

exportRecordId.description: The export record ID linking the document to the integration

tool_signatures.name: memories_archive
tool_signatures.description: Archive a stored long-term memory so it is no longer used at runtime.

tool_signatures.name: memories_list
tool_signatures.description: List current long-term memories stored for the current user/workspace.

tool_signatures.name: memories_save
tool_signatures.description: Save an explicit long-term memory or preference for the current user, workspace, or document.

tool_signatures.name: onboarding_status
tool_signatures.description: Get the user's onboarding/setup progress including which steps are completed and what's pending.

tool_signatures.name: rules_delete
tool_signatures.description: Delete an automation rule permanently. Use this when a rule, automation, or workflow should be removed entirely.

id.description: The ID of the automation rule to delete

tool_signatures.name: rules_disable
tool_signatures.description: Disable an automation rule without deleting it. Use this when a rule should stop running but remain available for later re-enabling.

id.description: The ID of the automation rule to disable

tool_signatures.name: rules_execute
tool_signatures.description: Create an automation rule from a natural language description. In Receiptor, rules, automations, and workflows refer to the same concept. Approval includes the generated rule details before creation.

naturalLanguageRule.description: Natural language description of the rule to create

tool_signatures.name: rules_list
tool_signatures.description: List automation rules for the user. In Receiptor, rules, automations, and workflows refer to the same concept. Shows rule information including name, status, trigger type, and execution stats.

tool_signatures.name: sources_email_delete
tool_signatures.description: Delete an email source from the account and stop monitoring it permanently.

tool_signatures.name: sources_email_disable-monitoring
tool_signatures.description: Disable monitoring for an email source without removing the connection.

tool_signatures.name: sources_email_enable-monitoring
tool_signatures.description: Enable monitoring for an email source to resume automatic document ingestion.

tool_signatures.name: sources_mobile-scanners_activate
tool_signatures.description: Activate a mobile scanner so documents from that number are processed again.

tool_signatures.name: sources_mobile-scanners_deactivate
tool_signatures.description: Deactivate a mobile scanner without deleting it.

tool_signatures.name: sources_mobile-scanners_delete
tool_signatures.description: Delete a mobile scanner from the account permanently.

tool_signatures.name: sources_mobile-scanners_disable-ai
tool_signatures.description: Disable AI extraction for a mobile scanner without removing the source.

tool_signatures.name: sources_mobile-scanners_enable-ai
tool_signatures.description: Enable AI extraction for a mobile scanner without changing the source registration.

tool_signatures.name: views_create
tool_signatures.description: Create a saved document view from document filters. Saved views are reusable inputs for rules, automations, and workflows.

sort.description: Optional sort configuration for the saved view

toDate.description: Absolute to date in YYYY-MM-DD format

amountEq.description: Exact amount filter in major units

fromDate.description: Absolute from date in YYYY-MM-DD format

amountMax.description: Maximum amount filter in major units

amountMin.description: Minimum amount filter in major units

tool_signatures.name: views_delete
tool_signatures.description: Delete a saved document view. Use this when a saved filter preset is no longer needed.

tool_signatures.name: views_list
tool_signatures.description: List saved document views for the current workspace. These saved views can be reused by rules, automations, and workflows.

tool_signatures.name: workspace_get_context
tool_signatures.description: Get the current workspace context (user, org, role, and effective ownership scope).

tool_signatures.name: workspace_switch
tool_signatures.description: Validate a target workspace and switch the active workspace for this MCP OAuth session.

tool_signatures.name: workspaces_list
tool_signatures.description: List available workspaces (organizations) for the authenticated user.
